purpose: Controlled Galaxy A/B for completed-fragment early delivery after stale-tab audit

conditions.network: Direct LAN connection to an isolated local KonomiTV backend
conditions.material: Nogizaka Koji-chu recording; measured targets 601/901 through 605/905 seconds
conditions.tab_rule: Zero page targets before each block, exactly one foreground watch tab while measuring, zero page targets after close
conditions.warmup: Targets 600 and 900 at the start of every block; excluded

builds.baseline: Validation build with timing, probe-sample, MSE-generation, and YADIF queue fixes; completed-fragment early delivery reverted
builds.fixed: Same validation build with upstream-source change 30ad508 adapted to the measured dependency

comparison.method: Difference of unpaired overall medians; 30,000 deterministic bootstrap resamples, seed 20260901
comparison.interpretation: All reported 95% intervals include zero. This controlled Galaxy run does not show lower first-fragment, append-complete, playing, or visible-canvas latency.

temporary_callback_instrumentation.scope: Temporary validation-only mark at the callback added by completed-fragment early delivery; not retained in the formal branch
temporary_callback_instrumentation.interpretation: The current callback overlaps second or later completed fragments with later work. It does not deliver the first media fragment needed for the initial post-seek frame earlier on these runs.

supersedes: The earlier sequential Galaxy comparison in galaxy-priority-fixes.json did not record tab count or randomize build order. Its approximately 28 ms difference remains historical evidence only and is not an effect estimate.
